name: shortify
description: Full-stack URL shortener and click analytics platform.

scripts.dev: npm run build --workspace=@shortify/shared && npm run dev --workspace=@shortify/api
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@shortify/shared && npm run build --workspace=@shortify/api && npm run build --workspace=@shortify/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace=@shortify/shared && npm run typecheck --workspace=@shortify/api && npm run typecheck --workspace=@shortify/web
